C0083.title: Malicious Merchants Use Fake QR Code Ads to Redirect Users to Counterfeit Product Pages
C0083.summary: On June 15, 2024, media reported that unscrupulous merchants embedded fake QR codes in advertisements to lure users onto pages selling counterfeit goods or into fraudulent loan schemes. Examples included scanning a bike-share QR code that led to a loan link, and scanning a parcel code that triggered an unwanted subscription.
